retired.title: Forecasters see Vietnam growing 7–8% in 2026, short of the ≥10% target
IMF path reaches 6,323 USD per person in 2030, short of 8,500 target
Forecasters put 2026 inflation at 4.2–4.9%; the target is about 4.5%
Population passed 100 million in 2023; 2050 projections: 110–115 million
SBV refinancing rate unchanged at 4.5% since June 2023
Easing moves outnumber tightening about four to one: 120 vs 29
Credit outgrew deposits in 9 of the 11 years since 2015
45% of Vietnam's bank credit goes to “other services” — mostly property and consumer loans
Dashboard scenario: at 15% credit growth, credit hits 178% of GDP by 2030
Q3 2026 was the busiest quarter, with 27 tracked documents
11 of 15 tracked drafts are due at the NA session opening 17 Oct
By 30 Sep, local budgets had disbursed 73.6% of plan; central 44.1%

chart_notes.30475882: Time slider 2020 → 2024 → 2025 (Year column; three steps, not equal years). x = GRDP per person USD, y = real GRDP growth %, size = average population, colour + dropdown filter = region; popups carry GRDP per person in million VND and NSO status. Fertility dropped from the axes: TFR exists for 2020 and 2024 only, so it has no 2025 frame. No search box: the Scatter template has no search setting; the region filter and legend are the find tools.
chart_notes.30476438: Bar chart race of GDP_SUB_OFFICIAL (19 NSO activities, % of GDP at current prices, 2010–2025) plus agriculture as one bar from GDP_SECTORS 'agr'. Captions dataset: data/flourish/gdp_by_activity_race_captions.csv. chapter 'panel-gdp' is the explore card in the econ appendix (#panel-gdp holds #gdp-sectors); stFlourish() only looks inside story roots (.st-root), so this card will not show on the page until the page code also scans that container.

items.title: Richest province's GRDP per person is 5.3× the poorest's, up from 4.8× in 2020
Manufacturing grew from 17.1% to 24.5% of GDP; mining fell from 4th to 13th
